summary: A debate over a second endorsement can turn on what the first endorsement means to voters.
realLife: The 31st District allowed multiple endorsements, but members arguing against a second assessor endorsement said sharing the recommendation reduced its value.
inGame: needs: first endorsement and rule on additional endorsements.

turns.pulledBy: The members want one clear recommendation.
turns.what: They oppose the second motion on that ground.
turns.writesBack: The debate can be recorded without impugning the second candidate.

turns.what: A member defends a shared endorsement.
turns.writesBack: The first endorsement does not automatically settle the next vote.
